item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.12 (29)
- Audio Mixer now leaves Tonale and its own playback helpers to Tonale, so the two apps can run together without Pro capturing Tonale-owned audio. - Improved audio helper identification and handling when a process exits or changes ownership. - Improved detection of the installed Tonale app, excluding build and release copies. - Updated shared player windows and audio effects controls. - Completed translations of 34 shared player labels in 25 languages.
